posts.subject: Temporary ban from fiddle
posts.bodyHtml:
At about 6PM this saturday 07/05/2016 i got a ban from Fiddle while I was IG for... Absolutly no reason. He just logged and banned me. So could I know for which reason?
The last map I played against him, he and Immanuel Cunt (it's his name) called me cheater. In this map indeed did a huge score.
I didn't camped more than 3 minutes in any place, I didn't spawnkill, I didn't shot into spawn. So why Fiddle banned me?

Is he serious?! I never cheat in my whole life, I played very long time in your server. THIS is an abuse of power. Speak with Ploiken or Vengence.
I'm a good play, I have a good aim skill but i'm still failable. I miss a lot of shots.
From which proof did he took his decision?
@Fiddles please explain what happend on the SDM Server, if possible at a Demo.

I don't have a demo of the map where Fiddle called me hacker.


I played with Awp & Tec9. With the awp I won a lot of duel against another awp by mostly headshot. I also did a lucky shot against Fiddle while he surfed and only half his head was visible. Another weird action was that time when he land near me (he could cut me), I shot without scoping and it was a head shot.
I don't remember any other incredible action.
With the Tec, almost all fight were at less than 1 meter between me and my opponent so i just had to not randomly spam the trigger to win the fight.
A short time after Immanuel Cunt joined, he claim he don't want to play against a cheater (me) so he stayed at spawn then moved to spectator. During this time, Fiddle was alone vs 2 other player and me. I killed him many time. Mostly because he rushed me with almost no health.
Some time after, other player joined, they were better than Fiddle with AWP and I die more often.


Then the map changedn we had to change again because it was bugged (the great river with the black screen at the end of a round). On Poolday i played a little bit againt the only other player left, few minutes later Fiddle connected and ban me without saying anything.


Speak with Ploiken, Vengence or Mario. I play since a loooong time in teh server (I have more than 32 400 stamm points). I have 930 hours on CS, i never had any ban on any steam game. With the awp i have more than 20k kills (only 13k on the stattrack) and about 6k on the tec. I would never, i say it again never, cheat on any player vs player game. I never had, i'll never do.
So i ask again, where are your "proofs" Fiddle?

Hello, I would like to give my side of the story. I was given a demo from I believe to be procured from Mike. His steam username is "Immanuel Cunt". This demo is on the teamspeak file browser for SurfDM. After conversing with him, he was very convinced to the fact that Bretzel was cheating on the surf deathmatch server. The demo displays that I was on at the same time as Bretzel on the surf deathmatch server, I also felt wary of his plays and how very irregular they were.


Within the demo, if viewed; you should be able to observe that his aim was not pointing to where he shot. As well as this, I was able to identify that at some moments, only when he was near to death, his movement and aiming all sped up and articulated to ensure a kill. This was irregular to the fact that this same pattern happened 3 times within the demo recorded.


Now with experience with hacks myself, from friends who bought them and tested them on me, I felt that Bretzel was hacking with some sort of aim assist. "Aimbot" was the closest reason for this. Immanuel Cunt also agreed with me on the irregularities.



Zitat von Bretzel

THIS is an abuse of power. Speak with Ploiken or Vengence

Now I can apologise that I had improperly incited your banning reason, as I assumed you would see it upon ban. But this is not an abuse of power, I see no power in this. But I have been given the rite of being able to ban/punish people if they hack/break the rules. Speaking with Ploiken or Vengeance justifies that it is an abuse? Even when I had plausible proof to the happening that you were banning upon.


I am sorry that you were banned, but a permanent ban was stated to me as protocol providing that I have evidence. As said by Sky when I was interviewed for my role as staff. Be sure to play on our other servers though as you were a very friendly player.

Zitat von Bretzel

Speak with Ploiken, Vengence or Mario. I play since a loooong time in teh server (I have more than 32 400 stamm points). I have 930 hours on CS, i never had any ban on any steam game. With the awp i have more than 20k kills (only 13k on the stattrack) and about 6k on the tec. I would never, i say it again never, cheat on any player vs player game. I never had, i'll never do.
So i ask again, where are your "proofs" Fiddle?

Neither does playtime or quantity of kills represent skill/cheating.

Don't you think i'll should be vac if i cheated? I'm not kqly, i can't afford an undetected cheat.
I ask it once again, show me your "proofs"

Zitat von Fiddles

Be sure to play on our other servers though as you were a very friendly player.

He can't because you perm banned him...
Regarding to your Post there is a Demo wich is (iyho) suspicious, then why not share them with other staff members before perm baning someone?
I'd like to see the demo aswell in order to get an own sight of the incident.


@Bretzel for now you need to be patient, because your ban WILL stay untill either Fiddles or any high Staff Member (SuperAdmin or higher) decides to unban you


GL,

Problem solved, you will be unbanned @Bretzel , thanks to @Ploiken how took a view of the demo

Thank,


sorry fiddle if i was a little rude, i was kind of upset. Except this incident, you do your admin job well.
